title: John Carmack's keynote at Quakecon 2013 part 4
summary: Part 4 of John Carmack's QuakeCon 2013 keynote, covering OpenGL, functional programming, Haskell, Lisp and Scheme, typing, multithreading, events and garbage collection.
why: Cited again and again as Carmack's key public statement on functional programming and purity in game development, plus his remarks on garbage collection.

quote.text: There's an old video [0] where he talks in-depth about his explorations of functional programming.
